baseline.name: PICO-8 runtime API Reference
baseline.scope: Canonical named functions documented in API Reference sections 6.1–6.14, plus sgn documented in the syntax primer. Include runtime cartridge lifecycle/filesystem and advanced Lua functions; exclude four host/editor command functions below. Input-device GPIO/mouse/keyboard facilities expressed via peek/poke/stat share those API rows; their subfeatures are not counted twice.
baseline.denominator_policy: One row per canonical name, not per alias or overload. time/t count once; overloads affect status, never denominator. Callback hooks _init/_update/_update60/_draw and syntax are measured separately. ipairs is a converter extension not counted in this official inventory.

excluded.name: resume
excluded.reason: Interactive shell command to resume stopped execution.

rubric.implemented_partial: Functional implementation exists for some behaviors. Not a claim of complete semantics or official-equivalent results.
rubric.missing: No implementation, or accepted silent no-op (sfx/music).
rubric.complete: Reserved for independently reference-verified full promised semantics; no rows meet this bar.
rubric.capability_status: supported means no specific semantic omission identified by this code audit; partial means a known API behavior is absent or approximated; missing means no functional implementation. These labels are independent of reference-equivalence validation and do not mean production-complete.

summary.warning: Name presence percentage is not project completion, API semantic fidelity, games compatibility or estimated remaining effort.

apis.name: load
apis.reason: Converts, so carts that only load another cartridge from a menu still run; calling it stops the cartridge with an explicit error because only one cartridge is on the device.

apis.name: save
apis.reason: No compiler binding or native runtime implementation.

apis.name: ls
apis.reason: Returns an empty table: the device has no host file system to list.

apis.name: run
apis.reason: Restarts the cartridge through the backend guard on both targets. The optional breadcrumb parameter is not stored for stat(6).

apis.name: stop
apis.reason: Halts with the optional message shown on the error screen; resuming is not available.

apis.name: assert
apis.reason: Truth condition/message and all supplied successful return values, including nil, within the 16-argument/result limit. Error-format equivalence has no independent reference suite.

apis.name: reset
apis.reason: Resets draw palette, transparency, screen and secondary palettes, camera, cursor, clip, colour and fill pattern.

apis.name: flip
apis.reason: Presents the frame drawn so far from inside generated code, advances audio and input state, collects garbage without moving strings and continues in the same call stack, on both the desktop host and the Pico frame loop.

apis.name: printh
apis.reason: Console output for strings and values; filename, overwrite and clipboard targets are ignored.

apis.name: time
apis.reason: Frame-count based seconds present (alias t); reset/timing/wrap edge cases unverified.

apis.name: stat
apis.reason: Memory, CPU (native budget ratio), version, frame rates, audio channel/note/pattern state (16-26, 46-57), idle mouse/keyboard queries and frame-derived clock values. Other indices fail explicitly; CPU and clock are not PICO-8-equivalent.

apis.name: extcmd
apis.reason: reset, pause and shutdown act on the device. Screenshot, recording, label and audio-capture commands need the PICO-8 host and are ignored.

apis.name: clip
apis.reason: Integer screen clipping/reset, fifth-argument intersection and four previous-rectangle results. Exact off-screen/fractional clipping state fidelity has not been established.

apis.name: pset
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: pget
apis.reason: Reads framebuffer pixels; custom out-of-bounds register setting and complete memory-mapped draw state absent.

apis.name: sget
apis.reason: Reads sprite pixels; custom out-of-bounds register setting and remapped sprite memory absent.

apis.name: sset
apis.reason: Explicit/default draw-colour sprite-pixel writes are implemented; remapped sprite memory remains absent.

apis.name: fget
apis.reason: Reads sprite flag bitfields/booleans; invalid sprite or bit indices return zero/false rather than wrapping. Independent reference equivalence remains unmeasured.

apis.name: fset
apis.reason: Writes flags/bitfield; bounded subset lacks reference edge-case comparison.

apis.name: print
apis.reason: ASCII raster font/basic cursor and newline implemented; extended P8SCII/control commands/custom fonts and exact return metrics incomplete.

apis.name: cursor
apis.reason: Sets/resets integer cursor position with optional draw colour and returns both previous coordinates; independent reference fidelity unmeasured.

apis.name: color
apis.reason: Basic draw colour get/set; extended colour/fill-pattern state unsupported.

apis.name: cls
apis.reason: Clears indexed framebuffer and resets clip/cursor; complete draw-state fidelity unverified.

apis.name: camera
apis.reason: Sets/resets integer camera coordinates and returns both previous coordinates through direct or first-class native calls; independent reference fidelity unmeasured.

apis.name: circ
apis.reason: Basic integer circle outline; fill patterns/extended draw state absent and raster fidelity unverified.

apis.name: circfill
apis.reason: Basic integer filled circle; fill patterns/extended draw state absent and raster fidelity unverified.

apis.name: oval
apis.reason: Ellipse outline inside the inclusive bounding box with fill-pattern support; pixel-exact equivalence with PICO-8 is unverified.

apis.name: ovalfill
apis.reason: Filled ellipse inside the inclusive bounding box with fill-pattern support; pixel-exact equivalence is unverified.

apis.name: line
apis.reason: Explicit endpoints, continuation, no-argument and colour-only pen reset implemented; fill patterns and exact raster fidelity remain incomplete/unverified.

apis.name: rect
apis.reason: Integer rectangle present; fill patterns/extended draw state absent and raster fidelity unverified.

apis.name: rectfill
apis.reason: Integer filled rectangle present; fill patterns/extended draw state absent and raster fidelity unverified.

apis.name: rrect
apis.reason: Rounded-rectangle outline with clamped corner radius and fill-pattern support; pixel-exact equivalence is unverified.

apis.name: rrectfill
apis.reason: Filled rounded rectangle with clamped corner radius and fill-pattern support; pixel-exact equivalence is unverified.

apis.name: pal
apis.reason: Draw, screen (including colours 128-143 on the LCD) and secondary palettes with numeric and bounded table forms and per-palette or full resets. Table/reset previous-state returns remain unverified.

apis.name: palt
apis.reason: Reset, colour/boolean and 16-bit mask overloads with previous-mask return; high bit controls colour 0, low bit colour 15. Independent reference fidelity unmeasured.

apis.name: spr
apis.reason: Integer whole-sprite dimensions/flips present; fractional size/fill-pattern/complete draw-state semantics incomplete.

apis.name: sspr
apis.reason: Positive-dimension scaling/flips present; resource limits and raster edge cases differ or unverified.

apis.name: fillp
apis.reason: 16-bit pattern with transparency bit and two-colour fills for shapes, lines and pixels, mirrored at 0x5f31-0x5f33. Sprite and secondary-palette pattern flags are not implemented.

apis.name: add
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: del
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: deli
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: count
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: all
apis.reason: Direct generic-for lowering plus a first-class iterator closure; both revisit a slot after del() shifts.

apis.name: foreach
apis.reason: Invokes native function values over the array portion; bounded table pool and mutation edge cases require broader equivalence tests.

apis.name: pairs
apis.reason: Direct generic-for lowering plus first-class next/table/nil triples, __pairs, and safe clearing of fields during traversal.

apis.name: btn
apis.reason: Six-button reads and bitfield for player one; documented players 1..7 have no controller attached and read as idle.

apis.name: btnp
apis.reason: Presses with held-button repeat honouring 0x5f5c delay and 0x5f5d interval (255 disables); players 1..7 read as idle.

apis.name: sfx
apis.reason: Silent on this LCD target, but stateful: channel allocation, offsets, lengths, loops, release and stop update a sequencer visible through stat(). No waveform output.

apis.name: music
apis.reason: Silent but stateful pattern sequencing with loop/stop flags, channel masks and pattern counters visible through stat(). Fades and waveform output are not implemented.

apis.name: mget
apis.reason: Default map plus shared gfx half supported; remapped map/width registers unsupported.

apis.name: mset
apis.reason: Default map plus shared gfx half supported; remapped map/width registers unsupported.

apis.name: map
apis.reason: Default map drawing/layer mask present; remapped memory, fill patterns and exact draw state incomplete.

apis.name: tline
apis.reason: Textured lines through map space with default and custom map steps, layer masks and 0x5f38-0x5f3b wrapping. The precision-bits overload and 0x5f36 options are unsupported.

apis.name: peek
apis.reason: Base RAM 0x0000-0x7fff maps onto sprite, map, flag, sound, user, cartdata, draw-state and screen memory, with multi-value counts. Upper memory 0x8000-0xffff reads zero and several hardware registers are stored without effect.

apis.name: poke
apis.reason: Writes the same base-RAM map, including draw-state and screen registers, with multiple values. Upper memory writes fail explicitly; screen-mode and other hardware registers are stored only.

apis.name: peek2
apis.reason: Signed 16-bit little-endian reads over the base-RAM map, plus the % operator. Same upper-memory and register limits as peek.

apis.name: poke2
apis.reason: 16-bit little-endian writes over the base-RAM map. Same upper-memory and register limits as poke.

apis.name: peek4
apis.reason: 32-bit fixed-point reads over the base-RAM map, plus the $ operator. Same upper-memory and register limits as peek.

apis.name: poke4
apis.reason: 32-bit fixed-point writes over the base-RAM map. Same upper-memory and register limits as poke.

apis.name: memcpy
apis.reason: Overlap-safe copies across the base-RAM map with range checks. Upper memory is unavailable.

apis.name: reload
apis.reason: Copies original cartridge ROM (sprites, map, flags, sound) into RAM, with defaults for a full reload. Loading from another cartridge file fails explicitly.

apis.name: cstore
apis.reason: No compiler binding or native runtime implementation.

apis.name: memset
apis.reason: Fills across the base-RAM map with range checks. Upper memory is unavailable.

apis.name: max
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: min
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: mid
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: flr
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: ceil
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: cos
apis.reason: Uses host libm then fixed-point conversion; bit-exact PICO-8 trig results unverified.

apis.name: sin
apis.reason: Uses host libm then fixed-point conversion; bit-exact PICO-8 trig results unverified.

apis.name: atan2
apis.reason: Uses host libm then fixed-point conversion; bit-exact PICO-8 results unverified.

apis.name: sqrt
apis.reason: Uses host libm then fixed-point conversion; bit-exact PICO-8 edge cases unverified.

apis.name: abs
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: rnd
apis.reason: Range/table choices use xorshift; RNG sequence differs from PICO-8 and negative ranges rejected.

apis.name: srand
apis.reason: Seeds xorshift; does not reproduce PICO-8 seeded random sequence.

apis.name: sgn
apis.reason: Core behavior implemented in bounded runtime; complete overload, coercion, numeric edge-case and reference-equivalence coverage unverified.

apis.name: band
apis.reason: Fixed-width bit operation with per-operand numeric conversion/zero fallback, including explicit nil and nonnumeric values. Numeric strings use the existing partial parser; accepted arities and 16-value call bound are unchanged. Operator type errors remain separate; no independent reference-equivalence suite.

apis.reason: Fixed-width bit operation with per-operand numeric conversion/zero fallback, including explicit nil and nonnumeric values. Numeric strings use the existing partial parser; accepted arities and 16-value call bound are unchanged. Operator type errors remain separate; no independent reference-equivalence suite.

apis.name: menuitem
apis.reason: Registers, replaces and removes up to five items. The Pico pause menu lists them and calls the callback with the button bitfield; a callback returning true does not keep the menu open, and the desktop host check has no menu.

apis.name: tostr
apis.reason: Numeric hexadecimal fixed/raw and signed raw-integer format flags, no-argument empty string and nil display implemented. Default decimal formatting is approximate; raw object-address formatting is rejected.

apis.name: tonum
apis.reason: Decimal text/numeric identity, exact fixed-point hexadecimal/binary forms, integer/hex flags and zero-on-failure flag implemented. Invalid conversion publishes zero results. Decimal rounding/overflow and other coercions remain incomplete; numeric identity retains its existing value.

apis.name: chr
apis.reason: Byte construction present; NUL byte rejected; at most 16 input arguments.

apis.name: ord
apis.reason: Scalar byte lookup and bounded in-range multi-result lookup up to 16 P8SCII bytes implemented. Zero/negative/oversized counts and multi-result ranges beyond the string are explicitly rejected; embedded-NUL strings remain unsupported.

apis.name: sub
apis.reason: Byte substring basics present; NUL-containing strings unsupported.

apis.name: split
apis.reason: Separator/chunk splitting with shared decimal/hex/binary numeric conversion and preserved invalid/empty tokens. NUL-containing strings and exact decimal conversion fidelity remain unsupported/incomplete.

apis.name: type
apis.reason: Types supported by native value model recognized; coroutine/thread type unavailable.

apis.name: cartdata
apis.reason: Opens the 64-number store once per run with a string id and returns false. Values are not persisted across power cycles yet.

apis.name: dget
apis.reason: Reads the 64 fixed-point values at 0x5e00; out-of-range indices read zero. No persistence across power cycles.

apis.name: dset
apis.reason: Writes the 64 fixed-point values at 0x5e00. No persistence across power cycles.

apis.name: serial
apis.reason: Accepts every channel and transfers nothing; no GPIO or USB serial channel is wired to it.

apis.name: setmetatable
apis.reason: Assigns or clears a table metatable and returns the table.

apis.name: getmetatable
apis.reason: Returns the metatable, or its __metatable field when present; non-tables return nil.

apis.name: rawset
apis.reason: Raw table mutation, nil-value deletion, non-nil key checks and receiver return. Existing bounded table/value model; no metatable implementation is implied.

apis.name: rawget
apis.reason: Raw table lookup for numeric, string and identity keys, including nil/missing reads. String indexing is a separate operation; rawget still requires a table. Existing bounded table/value model; no metatable implementation is implied.

apis.name: rawequal
apis.reason: Type-sensitive raw equality of values, interned strings and table/function identities within the existing bounded value model.

apis.name: rawlen
apis.reason: Raw length of bounded strings and contiguous table sequences; hash entries are excluded. Sparse-table borders are not uniquely defined by Lua.

apis.name: select
apis.reason: Numeric/count selectors, numeric-string decimal/hex/binary coercion and positive/negative tails implemented. At most 16 total arguments; vararg syntax remains a separate missing feature.

apis.name: cocreate
apis.reason: Creates a coroutine with its own native stack. The pool is 4 coroutines of 3 KB on the Pico (8 on the host) and errors inside a coroutine stop the cartridge instead of returning false from coresume.

apis.name: coresume
apis.reason: Resumes with arguments and returns true plus yielded or returned values; dead or running coroutines return false and a message. Same pool and error-propagation limits as cocreate.

apis.name: costatus
apis.reason: Reports suspended, running, normal or dead.

apis.name: yield
apis.reason: Suspends with values and returns the next resume arguments, including from nested native calls. Same pool and error-propagation limits as cocreate.

audit_notes: 2026-10-16: rechecked bindings and runtime after adding conditional host API profiling; capability statuses unchanged.

2026-10-16 small API gaps: four raw helpers and partial select added; camera/cursor previous returns and palt bitmask/state gate omissions closed. Clip, line and sset overloads improved but remain partial. Assert multi-results fixed. New original sanitizer fixture and negative cases; no reference-conformance or game-compatibility claims. See docs/SMALL-GAPS.md.

Second small-gap pass: numeric-string selectors; shared radix parser for tonum/split; numeric tostr/tonum flags; zero-result tonum failures; and bounded in-range multi-result ord. Existing API statuses remain unchanged because decimal, bounded-result and string limits remain. Original numeric_strings.p8 and controlled errors provide host evidence; no independent reference comparison. Added flag-index boundary assertions and zero/false invalid reads instead of wrapping; valid fset modes exercised.

Third small-gap pass: draw pal previous-register/table/reset behavior, strict leading-dot radix literals and native bitwise per-operand defaults added. Conflicting palette keys0/16 and unsupported forms fail explicitly; strict bitwise operators retain errors. New original fixtures exercise these subfeatures. Canonical implementation labels, scope, weights and reference-validation flags are unchanged.

Coverage pass (2026-10-16): memory map, cartdata, menuitem, flip, run/reset/stop/extcmd, shapes, fillp, tline, metatables, first-class iterators, coroutines and stateful silent audio added and re-audited against original fixture converter/tests/extended_features.p8 and new expected-error cases. sfx/music are no longer accepted no-ops: they drive observable sequencer state. Partial statuses record upper-memory, persistence, pool, pixel-equivalence and synthesis limits. No reference conformance is claimed.
Coverage pass (2026-10-18): ls and serial added as partial bindings; load converts and fails explicitly at runtime (still missing). save and cstore still stop conversion.
public_review: 2026-10-16: independently authored compact ASCII font; print remains partial. API implementation/status unchanged. Default public suite uses only original fixtures; external fixture pointers denote unbundled historical evidence. Small-gap follow-up uses only an original API boundary fixture and generated invalid-input cases; no external game source or device flashing.
